result.disposition: All ten frozen attempts were reopened against current exact pages. Four WINSPACE fields retain current trim-specific weights or drivetrain options, but the mainland coupon cards remain unmapped. The other six fields retain evidence-backed clearance, weight, material, and regional-BOM conflicts or unknowns; no unsupported value was selected.

field_results.caveat: Current manufacturer page lists fitted 700×40C but no maximum; the 25yr store claims 700×45C maximum with standard chainring and a 2024 manual mirror states 700×40C maximum. The retained listing generation/revision remains unmapped.
Current size-M/no-pedals references are approximately 8.6 kg 105 mechanical, 8.1 kg 105 Di2, and 7.8 kg Ultegra Di2. None maps to the retained CNY 13,599.20 coupon card.

Current original-T1600 size-M/no-pedals references are approximately 8.0 kg 105 Di2, 7.6 kg Ultegra Di2, and 7.2 kg Dura-Ace Di2. None maps to the retained CNY 22,400 card; no T1600 Ultra data was transferred.
The storefront states 2,560 g; corporate-page introduction states 2,507 g and its own table states 2,057 ± 40 g. No frame weight is selected.
Current exact pages distinguish hydraulic-disc 2×12 builds with Shimano 105 mechanical R7120, 105 Di2 R7170/R7150, and Ultegra Di2 R8170/R8150. The retained coupon trim remains unmapped.

Current original-T1600 pages distinguish hydraulic-disc 2×12 builds with 105 Di2 R7170/R7150, Ultegra Di2 R8170/R8150, and Dura-Ace Di2 R9270/R9250. The retained card remains unmapped; T1600 Ultra is excluded.
Probike states 9 kg for YTBR6i57SK without size-specific weighing or pedal basis. Allegro states 8.5 kg for size 53 without pedal or measurement basis. Neither supports a universal weight.
The storefront states Toray T700; the corporate page states T700/T800. No lay-up is selected.
